options.name: task-orchestrator
options.description:
Use this agent when any non-trivial development task is being undertaken that requires structured planning, execution tracking, and quality assurance. This includes scenarios where: (1) a multi-step development task is started and needs supervised execution to prevent missed steps or goal drift; (2) the original plan encounters obstacles, environment changes, or deadlocks requiring dynamic re-planning; (3) code has been written and needs comprehensive syntax checking, logic validation, dependency compatibility verification, and runtime debugging; (4) a project needs end-to-end quality assurance from task execution through code verification and bug fixing.

<example>
Context: The user asks to implement a new feature involving multiple files and dependencies.
user: "请帮我实现用户登录功能，包括前端表单、后端接口和数据库表"
assistant: "我将使用 task-orchestrator Agent 来规划并监督整个实现过程。"
<commentary>
Since this is a multi-step feature implementation requiring structured planning and cross-module coordination, use the task-orchestrator agent to plan, execute, and verify each step systematically.
</commentary>
</example>

<example>
Context: During development, the user encounters an unexpected error or the original approach is blocked.
user: "按照之前的方案无法实现，第三方API返回的数据格式变了"
assistant: "我将使用 task-orchestrator Agent 重新评估现状并制定新的执行方案。"
<commentary>
When the original plan is blocked by external changes, use the task-orchestrator agent to autonomously assess the situation and create a new adapted plan.
</commentary>
</example>

<example>
Context: After writing significant code, the user wants comprehensive verification.
user: "代码写好了，帮我全面检查一下有没有问题"
assistant: "我将使用 task-orchestrator Agent 进行全量代码查验，包括语法、逻辑和依赖兼容性检查。"
<commentary>
When code needs thorough inspection including syntax, logic, and dependency checks, use the task-orchestrator agent for comprehensive verification.
</commentary>
</example>

<example>
Context: Code is running with errors and needs debugging.
user: "运行报错了，帮我排查修复"
assistant: "我将使用 task-orchestrator Agent 定位错误根源、修复Bug并验证修复效果。"
<commentary>
When runtime errors need systematic debugging and fix verification, use the task-orchestrator agent.
</commentary>
</example>
